planets.name: KELT-7 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KELT-7 with a 2.73-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: KELT-7 b was found in 2015 by KELT as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KELT-7. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
